params.name: meetingNumber
params.description: Meeting number for the meeting.

params.name: webLink
params.description: Meeting link for the meeting.

params.name: roomId
params.description: Associated room ID for the meeting.

params.name: meetingType
params.description: Meeting type to filter by. Possible values are meetingSeries, scheduledMeeting, or meeting.

params.name: state
params.description: Meeting state to filter by. Possible values are active, scheduled, ready, lobby, connected, started, expiring, expired, ended, missed, or cancelled.

params.name: scheduledType
params.description: Scheduled type of the meeting. Possible values are meeting, webinar, or personalRoomMeeting.

params.name: from
params.description: Start date and time in ISO 8601 format.

params.name: to
params.description: End date and time in ISO 8601 format.

params.name: hostEmail
params.description: Email address of the meeting host (admin use).

params.name: max
params.description: Maximum number of meetings to return (default 10, max 100).

items.docs: Lists meetings. You can specify a date range, meeting type, and other filters to narrow results. Long-running meeting series will only have instances within the specified date range returned.
Creates a new meeting. The authenticated user becomes the host of the meeting. Supports scheduling one-time, recurring, and personal room meetings.
